items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: And Anita O'Day was my girl singer.

ctx.x: She did one of the greatest bits of acting that I have ever seen on the screen. Because firstly I knew Billie very well. I had known her, but we worked together. As a matter of fact, well let's see, it was after I left the Pollack band. I got back to Chicago and I formed my own band and I went

to 'The Three Deuces' I think it was. And Anita O'Day was my girl singer. And I had some fine musicians. An excellent band, all fine jazz musicians. A good arranger and Floyd Bean on the piano. And I was the MC of the deal and Billie Holiday was our star singing. And by the way, Art Tatum was playing the intermission piano.
